title: 第一卷第3章 她傻你们就可以欺负她第一卷第4章 蛮荒之森围杀
content_zh:
“要丹药？”
一家丹药铺内，胖掌柜看着一脸急切的阿傻，嗤笑不已。
“可以，拿元晶买，要多少我这里有多少！”
元晶。
乃是天地灵气浓缩汇聚而成，不仅可用作修炼，也是修行界中最为基础的货币。
“我……”
阿傻难过地摇摇头。
“我没有元晶……”
“那就滚蛋，别耽误我的生意！”
“可是我有这个！”
阿傻似想到了什么，小手一伸，拿出了三四颗拇指大小，形状不规则的透明晶体。
“少爷说这东西能换元晶的。”
“兽核？”
胖掌柜眼睛一亮，闪过一丝贪婪，面上却是不显露分毫。
“不过只是一阶兽核，不值什么钱！”
兽核。
乃是妖兽体内精华凝聚所在，不论是炼药抑或是炼器，都是不可或缺的一种珍贵材料。
一阶兽核虽然是最低级的，可也能值不少钱。
顾寒之所以伤上加伤，究其原因，便是在城外遇见了几只一阶妖兽。
“那怎么办……”

阿傻手足无措。
“我只有这么多了……”
“算了算了！”
胖掌柜抢也似地将兽核从阿傻手中拿走，随手扔出一瓶丹药。
“我这人心善，看你可怜，亏点就亏点，拿着吧！”
“谢谢！谢谢！”
阿傻喜出望外，如获至宝地接过丹药，也不顾身体上的伤痛，匆匆离开了店铺。
呸！
围观众人见到胖掌柜一副捡了大便宜的模样，暗骂不止。
真不是个东西！
连傻子都骗！
content_en:
"Want a pill?"
In a pill shop, the fat shopkeeper looked at the eager-looking Ah Sha and sneered.
"Okay, buy it with Yuan Jing. I have as much as you want here!"
Yuan Jing.
It is formed by the concentrated aura of heaven and earth. It can not only be used for cultivation, but is also the most basic currency in the world of cultivation.
"I..."
Ah Sha shook his head sadly.
"I don't have Yuanjing..."
"Then get out of here and don't delay my business!"
"But I have this!"
Ah Sha seemed to have thought of something. He stretched out his little hand and took out three or four transparent crystals about the size of a thumb with irregular shapes.
"The young master said this thing can be exchanged for Yuan Jing."
"Beast core?"
The fat shopkeeper's eyes lit up, and a trace of greed flashed through his face, but his face didn't show it at all.
"It's just a first-order beast core, not worth much!"
Beast core.
It is where the essence of the monster's body condenses. Whether it is refining medicine or refining weapons, it is an indispensable precious material.
Although the first-order beast core is the lowest level, it can still be worth a lot of money.
The reason why Gu Han suffered more injuries was because he encountered several first-order monsters outside the city.
"What should I do..."
Asha was at a loss.
"That's all I have left..."
"Forget it, forget it!"
The fat shopkeeper took the beast core from Ah Sha's hand like a grab, and threw out a bottle of elixir.
"I'm a kind-hearted person, but I feel sorry for you. If you lose anything, just lose it. Take it!"
"Thank you! Thank you!"
Ah Sha was overjoyed and took the elixir as if he had found a treasure. He hurriedly left the shop regardless of his physical pain.
Pooh!
The onlookers cursed secretly when they saw the fat shopkeeper looking like he had gotten a big deal.
It’s really not a thing!
Even fools are fooled!
